conservation.condition_narrative: "This painting is surface [sic] with Iso-Butyl Methacrylate 'Lucite 46' Mar. 1959" (typed label).
conservation.report_notes: Published with corresponding artwork entry in *Georgia O’Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné* (Lynes, 1999), this historical conservation information documents treatment decisions made during the artist’s lifetime. Lynes quotes information found on backing labels, and, when noted, from other sources.

cr_data.provenance: (Alfred Stieglitz, New York, NY); Jacob Strand, New York, NY, 1923; Paul Strand, New York, NY, before 1950; The New Gallery, New York, NY, 1950; Private collection, New York, NY, before 1952; Parke-Bernet Galleries, Inc., New York, NY, sale no. 1370, lot. no. 64, 22 October 1952; Private collection, New York, NY, 1952; Private collection, Rutherford, New Jersey, before 1992; Farleigh Dickinson College, Rutherford, New Jersey, bequest, before 1992; Sotheby's, New York, NY, sale no. 6374, lot no. 161, 3 December 1992 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Double entries Downtown Gallery Archive. Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Exam. at Mr. Strand's house, Feb. 1946. . . . No signature. Red canna––large purple leaf. Not in good condition. Crackle. Owned Mr. Jacob Strand . . . Information from Miss O'Keeffe: 'Red Canna with Dark Leaf' bought by Jack Strand from first exhibition at Anderson Galleries in 1923. Ptd. 1922. See gallery photograph 6–b (identified by O'Keeffe)." Pictured in 1923 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photographs, see Appendix III, figures 12, 17. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
